testcase.name: Scenario: Switch between details and thumbnail file views: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/document-opening/document-opening.feature:87:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch between details and thumbnail file views ✔ Given the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And a saved part with a preview is selected in the detailed file list ✔ And `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is selected in the detailed file list ✔ When the user chooses the thumbnail view control ✔ Then files are displayed as thumbnail tiles ✔ And the selected part remains selected with its file name and preview displayed ✔ When the user chooses the details view control ✔ Then files are displayed in rows with Name, Date modified, Type and Size columns ✔ And the selected part remains selected with its file name and preview displayed

testcase.name: Scenario: Change the selected document in thumbnail view: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/document-opening/document-opening.feature:310:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Change the selected document in thumbnail view ✔ Given writable copies of `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenDrawingA.odd`, `OpenDrawingB.odd` and `OpenPart.opd` are staged in the same working folder ✔ And the user opens and saves each drawing to establish its sheet preview, then closes the drawings ✔ Given the Open dialog in the MCAD Software displays a saved drawing and a saved part as thumbnails ✔ And the drawing thumbnail is selected with its sheet preview displayed ✔ And the Options pane shows the drawing loading choices ✔ And the working folder contains `OpenDrawingA.odd` and `OpenPart.opd` as thumbnails ✔ When the user selects the part thumbnail ✔ Then the part thumbnail is highlighted ✔ And the file name field identifies the part ✔ And the separate preview displays the part geometry ✔ And the Options pane displays Model State and Design View controls ✔ And the dialog remains open
